description: The bench rig since 2026-11-20: the MJKDZ INA228 breakout and its R100 shunt, K1 of the HW-316 as the DUT lead, and the bypass on channel RL2 of a MikroE Relay 2 Click driven from GPIO15 (docs/relay2-click-wiring.md). From 2026-11-21 the breakout sits about 5 cm from the ESP32-S3 carrier instead of stacked under its antenna, the same wiring (docs/rig-wiring.md section 3, 'Where the breakout sits').

wiring.kelvin: the sense lands on the shunt's own pins; the R100 is a two-terminal part, so the screws' share is inside the measured value (docs/rig-wiring.md section 1)

lead.description: HW-316 K1 (SRD-05VDC-SL-C), NC in series with the DUT's lead, active low

bypass.description: MikroE Relay 2 Click (MIKROE-1899), the LCA717 PhotoMOS on RL2's terminals, its input on the Click's RL2 control pin, active high

controller: ESP32-S3-N16R8 on a DSX063-1 screw-terminal carrier (WCH CH343P)
